gloss: joining a group; becoming a member

definitions.gloss: joining a group; becoming a member
definitions.explanation: The act of becoming part of a group or category, often implying acceptance or achievement.

examples.japanese: やっとチームの{仲間入|なかまい}りができた。
examples.english: I was finally able to join the team.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{億万長者|おくまんちょうじゃ}の{仲間入|なかまい}りを{果|は}たした。
examples.english: He achieved the status of becoming a billionaire.

examples.japanese: {先進国|せんしんこく}の{仲間入|なかまい}りをする。
examples.english: To join the ranks of developed nations.

notes:
{仲間入|なかまい}り means joining a group or being accepted into a category. A compound of {仲間|なかま} (companion/group) + {入|い}り (entering).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {仲間入|なかまい}りをする: to join the ranks of ~
- {仲間入|なかまい}りを{果|は}たす: to achieve membership in ~
- 〜の{仲間入|なかまい}りができる: to be able to join ~

USAGE:
Often used figuratively to describe reaching a milestone or entering an elite category, not just literal group membership.
- {先進国|せんしんこく}の{仲間入|なかまい}り: joining the ranks of developed nations
- {億万長者|おくまんちょうじゃ}の{仲間入|なかまい}り: entering the ranks of billionaires
- {大人|おとな}の{仲間入|なかまい}り: becoming an adult (figurative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {加入|かにゅう}: joining, enrollment (formal, for organizations/subscriptions)
- {参加|さんか}: participation (for activities/events)
- {入会|にゅうかい}: joining a club/association
